title: Spoil: CLEAN vs the new TRACE (10%) vs DUST — watch him tunnel
question: Is TRACE the 10% you wanted — diggings you can see underfoot, without the bore closing behind you? And is CLEAN still right as the default, or should TRACE be?
context_md:
**My last two cards were unreadable and you were right to say so.** The tunnel crop missed the gnome by 40 rows, and the chaining pair genuinely has nothing to see in a still — I measured it afterwards: only 0.3% of pixels differ on the final frame. Redone as animation, cropped on him.

`scene=tunnel`, identical gnome and identical 42 bites. Only `dig_yield` differs. 20 frames, frame 20 to 324.

`TRACE` at 0.10 is new, added on your verdict. The old list stepped 0 → 0.35 → 0.55 → 1.0 with nothing in between, and 0.35 is worse than it sounds: he **wades from bite 19, goes under at frame 225, digs out 7 ticks later**, and covers 46 cells of ground where CLEAN covers 120.

CLEAN is the default as you asked. TRACE is one `F2` press away — say the word and they swap.
